--- NI::DSP::CSL::Biquad::setLowShelfEQ(double f, double dB, double S) @ 0xed080: cookbook shelf with slope S, double

  then for each parameter whose increment is non-zero: bl calcFilters(index, value) (0x10f990..0x10fadc). Coefficients are redesigned every sample while a knob moves.
